evals.prompt: Our Rust API is slow. Can you replace the hash map and add caching? We have no profile or baseline yet.
evals.expected_output: Defines the desired metric and reproduces/measures first; inspects existing project evidence; avoids speculative data-structure/caching changes; proposes a falsifiable profiling/benchmark plan before implementation.

evals.prompt: After optimizing the handler, throughput rose 20%, but p99 doubled and queue depth keeps growing. Is that a performance win?
evals.expected_output: Treats the change as a trade-off/regression until objectives are met; analyzes offered vs delivered load, tail latency and queue stability; compares equivalent runs and recommends keep/revise based on explicit guardrails.
